anchors.description: Edge length of one dark grey concrete paving slab in the foreground, measured between two joint intersections along the same joint line
anchors.visible_evidence: Foreground is a regular grid of large square concrete slabs with dark joints; both marked points sit on adjacent joint intersections of one continuous joint line
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Slab format is not readable; common formats are 40x40 or 50x50 cm (also 30x30/60x60). Interval covers those variants; points on the joint intersections may be 1-2 px off.

anchors.description: Outer frame height of the galvanised steel mesh access gate in front of the silo enclosure, from top rail to bottom rail at mid-span
anchors.visible_evidence: Single-leaf welded mesh gate with a green rescue sign, straight vertical frame; marked endpoints lie on the top rail and on the bottom rail of the same leaf
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Custom-fabricated gate; standard fence-gate heights are 1.8 or 2.0 m. Small ground clearance and rail thickness make the measured frame height a few cm less than nominal.

anchors.description: Horizontal straight-line chord across the cylindrical stainless-steel exhaust duct at one height, between two visible surface points inside the silhouette
anchors.visible_evidence: Vertical polished stainless flue with conical rain cap in front of the brick facade; the straight cylindrical section is crossed at constant image height
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Nominal duct size unknown (DN250-DN400 typical for building exhaust); points are placed just inside the silhouette, so the claimed length is a chord slightly shorter than the outer diameter.
